我的朋友欧文(My Friend Owen): 围绕旅行出行的A1短文:介绍杰克的日常、喜好与售票处。
Jack wears a hat today. The old town is big and clean. My friend Owen is very kind. In fact, the old railway is now a bike path.
We often go to the park together. The ticket office is not far from my home. I like my life very much. You can politely refuse food you do not like.
The ticket office is my favorite place. Jack wants to visit Rome. Owen likes bread too.
